title: Normalize CSV headers
goal: Normalize CSV header names into stable JavaScript keys.

requirements.text: Export normalizeCsvHeaders(headers).
Require headers to be an array of strings; throw TypeError otherwise.
Trim leading and trailing whitespace, lowercase with Unicode lowercasing, and replace each run of non-ASCII-alphanumeric characters with a single underscore.
Remove leading and trailing underscores; an empty normalized header is the empty string.
Preserve input order and do not mutate the input array.
Return an array of normalized strings without deduplicating.

title: Calculate invoice totals
goal: Calculate line totals, tax, and a final invoice total using integer cents.

requirements.text: Export calculateInvoiceTotals(lines, taxRatePercent).
Require lines to be an array of objects with non-negative integer quantity and unitCents; require taxRatePercent to be a finite non-negative number, otherwise throw TypeError.
Line subtotal is quantity multiplied by unitCents; subtotalCents is the exact sum of line subtotals.
Tax is round-half-up to the nearest cent from subtotalCents * taxRatePercent / 100; use integer arithmetic semantics for the final rounding.
Return {subtotalCents, taxCents, totalCents}, where totalCents is subtotalCents plus taxCents.
Do not mutate input lines.

title: Allocate inventory FIFO
goal: Allocate a requested quantity from inventory lots in first-in-first-out order.

requirements.text: Export allocateInventoryFifo(lots, requested).
Require lots to be an array and requested to be a non-negative integer; each lot must have a string id and non-negative integer quantity, otherwise throw TypeError.
Consume lots in array order, taking the smallest of remaining lot quantity and remaining requested quantity.
Return {allocations, remaining}, where allocations contains only consumed lots as {id, quantity} and remaining is unmet quantity.
Do not mutate lots and omit zero-quantity allocations.
Return empty allocations and remaining zero for a zero request.

title: Match payments to invoices
goal: Apply payments to invoices deterministically and report unmatched amounts.

requirements.text: Export matchPaymentsToInvoices(invoices, payments).
Require both arguments to be arrays; invoice and payment records require string id and non-negative integer cents, otherwise throw TypeError.
Process payments in input order and apply each payment to the first invoice in input order that still has an unpaid balance.
Return {matches, unmatchedCents, balances}; each match is {paymentId, invoiceId, cents}, balances is an array of {invoiceId, remainingCents} in invoice order.
A payment may create multiple matches; never create zero-cent matches.
Do not mutate either input array or their records.

title: Parse pagination query
goal: Parse bounded pagination parameters from a query string or URLSearchParams.

requirements.text: Export parsePaginationQuery(input, defaults = {}).
Accept a string query with or without a leading question mark, or a URLSearchParams instance; reject other inputs with TypeError.
Use page default 1 and limit default 20; defaults may provide positive integer page and limit, with maximum limit default 100.
Parse page and limit as base-10 integers and clamp page to at least 1 and limit to the inclusive range 1..100.
Invalid or missing values use the corresponding default; repeated keys use the first value.
Return a new object {page, limit} and do not mutate inputs.

title: Redact sensitive fields
goal: Deeply redact configured sensitive object fields without changing the source value.

requirements.text: Export redactSensitiveFields(value, fields = ['password','token','secret']).
Fields must be an array of strings; throw TypeError otherwise.
Recursively copy plain objects and arrays; when an object key exactly matches a configured field, replace its value with '[REDACTED]' without traversing that value.
Preserve primitives and non-plain objects by reference; null remains null.
Return a deep copy for arrays and plain objects and do not mutate the input.
Use the configured field names exactly and case-sensitively.

title: Dedupe events
goal: Remove duplicate events while retaining the first occurrence order.

requirements.text: Export dedupeEvents(events).
Require an array of objects each containing a string id and finite numeric timestamp; throw TypeError otherwise.
Events with the same id are duplicates regardless of timestamp; keep the event with the earliest array position.
Return a new array in first-occurrence order and do not mutate events or event records.
An empty input returns an empty array.

title: Build query string
goal: Build a deterministic URL query string from scalar and repeated values.

requirements.text: Export buildQueryString(params).
Require a non-null non-array object; throw TypeError otherwise.
Sort keys by JavaScript default lexicographic order and omit entries whose value is null or undefined.
For array values emit one key-value pair per element in array order; scalar values emit one pair.
Encode keys and values with encodeURIComponent and represent booleans as true or false; convert other non-null values with String.
Return the query without a leading question mark; an empty result is the empty string.

title: Resolve feature flags
goal: Resolve feature flags from defaults, environment, and per-user overrides.

requirements.text: Export resolveFeatureFlags(definitions, environment = {}, user = {}).
Require each of the three arguments to be non-null plain objects; throw TypeError otherwise.
Definitions map flag names to boolean defaults; non-boolean definitions are invalid and throw TypeError.
Start with definition defaults, then apply environment values, then user values; only boolean overrides are accepted and unknown keys are ignored.
Return a new object with definition keys in their original insertion order.
Do not mutate any input object.

title: Resolve permissions
goal: Resolve allow and deny permission rules with deny precedence.

requirements.text: Export resolvePermissions(rules, requested).
Require rules to be an array and requested to be an array of strings or {permission, scope} objects; malformed entries throw TypeError.
Each rule has string permission, boolean allow, and optional string scope; invalid records throw TypeError.
A rule applies when its scope is absent or equals the requested entry's scope; requested entries may be strings or {permission, scope} objects.
For each requested entry, the last applicable rule wins, and an explicit deny beats an allow at the same specificity; missing decisions are false.
Return an array of {permission, scope, allowed} in requested order and do not mutate inputs.

title: Overlap date ranges
goal: Compute overlap for ISO date-only inclusive ranges without local timezone behavior.

requirements.text: Export overlapDateRanges(left, right).
Each range must be [start, end] ISO YYYY-MM-DD strings; invalid dates or start after end throw TypeError.
Interpret dates as calendar dates, not timestamps or local-time Date values.
Return null when ranges do not overlap; otherwise return the inclusive intersection as [max(start), min(end)] in ISO date format.
A one-day intersection is valid.
Do not mutate either input range.

title: Aggregate order lines
goal: Aggregate order lines by SKU while retaining first-seen order.

requirements.text: Export aggregateOrderLines(lines).
Require an array of objects with non-empty string sku, non-negative integer quantity, and integer unitCents; invalid records throw TypeError.
Group by exact sku in first-seen order and sum quantities.
For each group retain the first line's unitCents and calculate totalCents as summed quantity times that unitCents.
Return {sku, quantity, unitCents, totalCents} objects and do not mutate inputs.
Return an empty array for an empty input.

title: Apply tiered discount
goal: Apply the highest eligible percentage discount to a subtotal in cents.

requirements.text: Export applyTieredDiscount(subtotalCents, tiers).
Require subtotalCents to be a non-negative integer and tiers to be an array of {minimumCents, percent}; invalid values throw TypeError.
A tier is eligible when subtotalCents is at least minimumCents; percent is finite and in the inclusive range 0..100.
Choose the eligible tier with the greatest minimumCents; ties use first array order.
Discount cents is round-half-up subtotalCents * percent / 100 and finalCents is subtotalCents minus discountCents.
Return {percent, discountCents, finalCents}; use percent 0 when no tier is eligible and do not mutate tiers.

title: Canonicalize headers
goal: Canonicalize HTTP-like header names and values while preserving meaningful duplicates.

requirements.text: Export canonicalizeHeaders(headers).
Require a non-null plain object whose values are strings or arrays of strings; invalid values throw TypeError.
Trim header names and values, lowercase names, and collapse each value's internal ASCII whitespace run to one space.
Sort output entries by lowercase header name using default lexicographic order.
For array values output one entry per value in original array order; preserve duplicate names as separate entries.
Return an array of {name, value} and do not mutate headers.

title: Plan upload chunks
goal: Plan contiguous upload chunks with a bounded chunk size.

requirements.text: Export planUploadChunks(totalBytes, chunkSize).
Require both arguments to be positive integers; otherwise throw TypeError.
Return an array of {index, offset, size} covering exactly 0 through totalBytes without gaps or overlap.
Each size is at most chunkSize, indexes start at 0, and offsets are zero-based.
The final chunk may be smaller; exact multiples do not receive an extra empty chunk.
Do not use randomness or mutate any input.

title: Create TTL cache
goal: Create a small TTL cache using an injected clock.

requirements.text: Export createTtlCache(ttlMs, now).
Require ttlMs to be a non-negative finite number and now to be a function; otherwise throw TypeError.
Return an object with get(key), set(key, value), has(key), and delete(key) methods.
A value is valid while now() minus its set time is less than ttlMs; expired entries are treated as absent and removed on access.
set returns the cache object; delete returns whether an entry existed and get returns undefined for absent entries.
Use the injected now function for every expiry check and do not use timers or wall-clock globals.

title: Map with concurrency limit
goal: Map over inputs with a strict maximum number of active asynchronous workers.

requirements.text: Export async mapWithConcurrencyLimit(items, limit, mapper).
Require items to be an array, limit to be a positive integer, and mapper to be a function; otherwise reject with TypeError.
Invoke mapper(value, index) for every item and return results in input order.
Never have more than limit mapper calls active at once; start later work as earlier work settles.
If a mapper rejects, reject the returned promise with that error while allowing already-started calls to settle.
Do not mutate items.

title: Select localized value
goal: Select the best localized value using deterministic language fallback.

requirements.text: Export selectLocalizedValue(values, requested, fallback = 'en').
Require values to be a non-null plain object and requested/fallback to strings; otherwise throw TypeError.
Try an exact requested locale, then its language subtag before trying fallback exact and fallback language subtag.

Locale matching is case-insensitive but keys are returned by their original values object lookup semantics; select the first matching key in values insertion order when normalized locale labels collide.
Return the matching value, including falsy values; return undefined when no locale matches.
Do not mutate values.

title: Validate customer update
goal: Validate a partial customer update and report stable field errors.

requirements.text: Export validateCustomerUpdate(update).
Require a non-null plain object; otherwise throw TypeError.
Allowed fields are name, email, phone, and marketingOptIn; unknown fields produce errors.
When present, name is a non-empty trimmed string, email contains exactly one @ with non-empty sides, phone matches optional leading plus followed by 7..15 digits, and marketingOptIn is boolean.
Return {valid, errors}; errors is an array of {field, message} sorted by input field order, with at most one error per field.
Do not mutate update.

title: Calculate reorder recommendation
goal: Calculate reorder quantity from stock, demand, and a safety-stock policy.

requirements.text: Export calculateReorderRecommendation(input).
Require a plain object with non-negative integer onHand, reserved, reorderPoint, and targetStock; invalid values throw TypeError.
Available stock is max(0, onHand - reserved).
If available stock is at least reorderPoint, recommend zero; otherwise recommend max(0, targetStock - available stock).
Return {available, reorder, needsReorder} where needsReorder is reorder greater than zero.
Do not mutate input and do not use randomness or time.
